verdict.rationale: Dover is a recruiting/ATS platform with built-in AI features, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client, and the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can consume external MCP servers or use their tools. The generic mention of connecting 'AI tools' is an adjacent integration claim, not documented MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
